name: Dang Vu (Matt)
paragraphs: I'm a software engineer. I work mostly in TypeScript, React, Next.js and Node, and I like taking a feature from nothing to something people actually use.
My journey started at FPT Software as a trainee. That's where I learned React and got my first real look at how software is built inside a company.

From there I moved to Bravebits and spent my time on PageFly, a page builder merchants use for their Shopify storefronts. I worked on both the frontend and the backend. I built tools that turn a screenshot or a Figma design into a real page, moved the editor to a more flexible layout system, and made the app faster so it could meet Shopify's Built for Shopify standard.

Then I moved to sending.ac, where I helped build the product from the ground up with a small team. I connected it to several email-sending tools so mailbox activity syncs every day, automated buying domains across more than one registrar, and built the new dashboard that replaced the old one.
If you're working on something I could help with, I'd be glad to hear from you.
